description_en: Queries the tasks in a specified task flow
description_zh: 调用ListTasksInTaskFlow接口，获取指定任务流的任务节点列表
name: ListTasksInTaskFlow

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

To view the ID of the tenant, move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the Data Management (DMS) console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
鼠标移动到界面右上角的头像处，查看租户ID。具体操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The ID of the task flow. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424565.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html operation to query the task flow ID
parameters.help_zh: 任务流ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424565.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/426672.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: dag_id

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned if the request failed

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the request failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误信息
ErrorMessage.example: The task flow does not exist or you do not have the permission.

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. You can use the ID to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID，用于定位日志，排查问题

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
请求是否成功，返回值如下：
true：请求成功
false：请求失败

Task.description_en: The tasks in the task flow

GraphParam.description_en: The position of the node on the Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG)
GraphParam.description_zh: 节点在图上的显示位置

NodeConfig.description_en: The advanced configuration for the node
NodeConfig.example: {     "rerun":{ // 必填固定值         "rerunEnable":true, // 是否开启重跑         "rerunCount":1, // 重跑次数         "rerunInterval":10 // 重跑间隔     } }

NodeContent.example: {     "dbId":123456, // 数据库Id     "sql":"/* 请使用当前节点所选择的数据库语法编写SQL */", // sql语句     "dbType":"polardb" // 数据库类型 }

NodeOutput.description_en: The output variables for the task
NodeOutput.example: {     "outputs":[         {             /*             变量提取设置             {                 "row":0, // 行，-1为所有行                 "column":-1, // 列，-1为所有列                 /*                 分隔符                 当选中所有行或所有列时，需要指定连接符。变量返回值为字符串                 */                 "combiner":","              }             */             "extractMethod":"{\"row\":0,\"column\":-1,\"combiner\":\",\"}",              "variableName":"var", // 变量名             "description":"For demo" // 变量介绍         }     ] }

NodeType.description_en: The type of the node. For more information about the valid values for this parameter, see [NodeType parameter]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424705.html）
NodeType.description_zh: 任务节点类型，返回值请参见[NodeType参数说明]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424705.html）

TimeVariables.description_en: The time variables configured for the node
TimeVariables.description_zh: 节点变量（时间变量配置）
TimeVariables.example: {   "variables":[     // "variables"为固定值     {       "name":"var", // name指定变量名       "pattern":"yyyy-MM-dd|+0m+0h-2d+0w+0M+1y" // 见后面解释     }   ] }
